story.title: First Trip to New York
story.situation: Jieun, a first-time traveler from Korea, arrives at JFK Airport and must navigate her way to her hotel in Manhattan, completing essential travel tasks in English for the first time.
story.summary: Jieun lands at JFK Airport, goes through immigration and baggage claim, finds ground transportation to Manhattan, checks into her hotel, and takes a first evening walk to experience the city atmosphere.

carry_in_state: Jieun is on an airplane approaching JFK Airport
She feels excited but slightly anxious about her first visit to New York
She has her passport, luggage, and hotel reservation ready
Her main goal is to get from the airport to her hotel safely
carry_out_state: Jieun has arrived at her hotel in Manhattan and checked in successfully
She has completed her first evening walk, feeling more comfortable with the city
She has used English for immigration, transportation, and hotel check-in
She is ready to explore more of New York the next day
